impact: Discrete ARI-connected basin-first selection failed on P22 and MISAR.
correction_or_disposition: Kept as matched control; did not delete rows or relabel it as success.

impact: The first 47-candidate bank had no ordered energy/graph-scale continuation, so persistence would have been ordinary partition consensus.
correction_or_disposition: Added a fixed seven-level pairwise-strength path for six starts before formal fitting.

impact: The first generator draft wrote artifact_reload=PASS without reopening the saved artifact.
correction_or_disposition: Generator now reopens IDs and partitions, checks exact equality and hashes, and only then records PASS; all four final 42-row path banks were regenerated.

impact: Convenience scout calibration loaded all four evaluation tables in one process.
correction_or_disposition: Formal LOSO fitting was split: each fit process opened only three training-study evaluation tables and hashed its config before a separate held-out evaluator ran.

impact: The first grid-fit implementation redundantly recomputed candidate-pair axes and was stopped before producing a fitted artifact.
correction_or_disposition: Mathematically identical fixed rank axes were precomputed; no scientific result from the stopped process was used.

impact: The inherited Night-16F replay auditor expected a manifest field absent from the Night-16G selector manifest and raised KeyError.
correction_or_disposition: Added a Night-16G-specific exact replay auditor; the failed invocation produced no scientific output.

impact: The winning global configuration set persistence_weight=0; the best globally ranked positive-persistence configuration collapsed MISAR.
correction_or_disposition: Report the formal object as a molecular/topology/cluster-risk multi-evidence selector, not a persistent-basin method.
